name: Ratio Energies - Limited Partnership
summary: Ratio Energies - Limited Partnership, together with its subsidiaries, explores, develops, produces, and markets natural gas and oil in Israel. The company operates the Leviathan project located in the Eastern Mediterranean Sea. It also exports its products to Jordan and Egypt. The company was formerly known as Ratio Oil Explorations (1992)  Limited Partnership and changed its name to Ratio Energies - Limited Partnership in February 2022. Ratio Energies - Limited Partnership was founded in 1992 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel.
